name: FOFO
intro: 本文提出了FOFO，一个开创性的基准，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）遵循复杂、特定领域格式的能力，这是它们作为AI代理应用的一个关键但未被充分研究的能力。FOFO通过AI与人类协作的方法，开发了多样的真实世界格式和指令，填补了现有基准在评估格式遵循能力方面的空白。
org: Salesforce Research, University of Illinois at Chicago, Pennsylvania State University
build_method: 专家领域种子与GPT-4扩展, 专用格式生成与人工复核, FORMAT-INSTRU生成与逐条核验
task_type: 格式化文本生成, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 缺少任一格式要求即失败, GPT-4二元判断与解释, 100题人工一致性复核
build_method_en: Expert Domain Seeds plus GPT-4 Expansion, Domain-format Generation and Human Review, FORMAT-INSTRU Generation and Per-item Verification
eval_feature_en: Any Missing Format Requirement Fails, GPT-4 Binary Verdict plus Explanation, 100-item Human Agreement Check
intro_en: This paper introduces FOFO, a pioneering benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLM) ability to follow complex, domain-specific formats—a critical yet underexplored capability for their use as AI agents. FOFO employs AI-human collaboration to develop diverse real-world formats and instructions, addressing the gap in existing benchmarks for assessing format adherence.

drawio_review_note: Paper-aligned against arXiv:2402.18667v1 Sections 3.1-3.3, Tables 1-3, and Appendix A, then release-audited against SalesforceAIResearch/FoFo commit 140b1661355672cce9ba84dbf8c9060980126581 (a post-paper snapshot). Pinned evidence includes data/fofo_test_prompts.json SHA-256 8f4cddcb5667dc320a5d444a05d3d24657cf7b5f5a3aea2146ba92c4540c8f3b, domain_subdomain_list.json d2398335fa57c06d8415a18d7878163c41fef69a3187d82b97bb669a5d345dab, and format_list.json c74c8d3c403a8115acd2f2c347e3ca0ba239113cdf41fd9a2b7e4362204fcf9a. The pinned candidate file has 500 domain/subdomain/format rows and 254 unique format strings; after expert review, generic-format reinsertion, and per-item instruction review, the test release has 494 FORMAT-INSTRU items over 248 unique formats, averaging 2,908 characters. The official inference script wraps Alpaca, Vicuna/WizardLM, Mistral, Zephyr, and OpenChat families (otherwise raw), then samples with temperature 0.7, top-p 1, and 5,120 maximum new tokens. The GPT-4 evaluator config SHA-256 18cd1a0bcf89113b56b6a4f300e6bc62abb7c5f4d5724c32f973a9e05fcafc0 uses max_tokens 1,024, temperature 0, json_parser, and key format_correctness; its prompt SHA-256 is f2e93dc7e56715789c22f65bca305fbcc6d4501003083fe4befe424f08d0eea5. Accuracy is 100 times n_correct/n_total after retaining binary labels. The paper's 100-response human audit agrees on 84 and identifies all 16 disagreements as GPT-4 false positives.
